changes.evidence: Frank's PRIDE membership is backstory only: years before the series he found out about Leslie's affair with Jonah, PRIDE wiped his memory with the Synnergy Serum, and he was out of PRIDE (seen only in S1 flashbacks). In the present-day story the wiki says outright that he 'was not part of PRIDE' and that Jonah 'had thrown him out of PRIDE'. He stays in the Church of Gibborim until the adepts turn on him and lock him up in S2 episode 12 (episode 22 overall).

owner_calls.question: In Runaways S3 episode 8 AWOL is in the Dark Dimension, where he commands a squad of Dark Dimension soldiers (alongside the Dark Dimension Darius Davis) and works under someone else's orders. His last stage is still LAPD. Should S3 record a move?
options: Keep as is (LAPD; being trapped in the Dark Dimension is like being held, so no move)
Add a Dark Dimension soldiers group at "Runaways S3"
owner_calls.evidence: Nico's spell in S2 episode 10 (episode 20 overall) sends AWOL to the Dark Dimension. There 'AWOL gathered up a team and paraded the streets for prisoners... he was under orders to simply capture them' (RW308). The battle page lists his side as AWOL and Dark Dimension Soldiers, with AWOL and the Dark Dimension Darius Davis as commanders.
